description: Buddy Phase 6 — Execution Intelligence & Portfolio Protection. Phase 5 hardened safety gates. Phase 6 improves trade *quality*: trailing stops to lock in profits, correlation enforcement to prevent hidden exposure, per-profile consensus tuning, RL feedback reconnection, code cleanup, and learnings consolidation. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP BRAINSTORMING/RESEARCHING AND IMPROVING. DONT ASK FOR EVERY COMMAND, JUST DO. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Per-profile agent consensus thresholds
userStories.description: As a configurable system, each scan profile should enforce its own minimum agent consensus ratio. Conservative needs stricter consensus than aggressive.
acceptanceCriteria: SCAN_PROFILES in config.py includes min_agent_consensus_ratio per profile
conservative=0.42 (5/12), balanced=0.33 (4/12), aggressive=0.25 (3/12), smart=0.33 (4/12)
Engine reads the per-profile value from config, not just the global default
Syntax validation passes
Status dashboard shows active consensus threshold
userStories.notes: Per-profile min_agent_consensus_ratio added to all 4 SCAN_PROFILES in config.py. Engine reads from profile config.

userStories.title: ATR-based trailing stop loss for open positions
userStories.description: As a profit-protecting system, open trades should have trailing stops that lock in gains. Currently positions ride through full adverse swings with no dynamic SL adjustment.
acceptanceCriteria: New method in execution.py: update_trailing_stops() adjusts SL toward profit
Trail distance = ATR * trailing_atr_multiplier (default 1.5x)
Only moves SL in profitable direction (never widens)
Integrates with OANDA trade modify API to update SL on server
Logs every trailing SL adjustment to observations.jsonl
Configurable via ScannerConfig: enable_trailing_stop, trailing_atr_multiplier
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: update_trailing_stops() added to execution.py. ATR * 1.5 trail distance. Only moves SL toward profit (LONG: up, SHORT: down). OANDA PUT modify API. Logged to observations.jsonl. Wired into continuous.py monitoring loop between drawdown guardian and RL sync.

userStories.title: Enforce correlation filter before trade execution
userStories.description: As a portfolio protector, the DiversificationFilter must actively block trades on correlated pairs when exposure limit is reached. Currently the filter exists but is not wired into execution.
acceptanceCriteria: execution.py checks correlation exposure BEFORE placing any order
If pair is correlated (>0.7) with an already-open position AND max_correlated_exposure reached, skip trade
Log blocked trades with reason: 'correlated pair X already open'
max_correlated_exposure configurable (default 2)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: _check_correlation_exposure() added to execution.py. Uses correlation_group_config to check group membership. Counts open trades in same group. Blocks if >= max_correlated_exposure (default 2). Logs to observations.jsonl category='correlation_block'. Called in execute_trade() before OANDA init.

userStories.title: RL trade outcome sync to agent weight learning
userStories.description: As a self-improving system, every closed trade must feed back into RL reward signals. Currently agent weights update but the RL sizer/gates/exits models never receive live trade outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: New method: _sync_trade_outcome_to_rl(trade_result) in execution.py
Appends (state, action, reward) tuples to RL replay buffer file
Reward = normalized P/L relative to risk taken (pnl / sl_pips)
Called automatically after every trade close detection
RL buffer persists to trained_data/rl_replay_buffer.jsonl
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: _sync_trade_outcome_to_rl() added. State includes pair, direction, confidence, atr, regime, consensus, uncertainty. Action includes lots, sl_pips, tp_pips. Reward = pnl_pips / sl_pips. Appends JSONL to trained_data/rl_replay_buffer.jsonl. Called automatically in sync_closed_trades_rl() after each trade match.

userStories.title: Remove orphan agents.py and consolidate learnings
userStories.description: As a maintainable codebase, dead code must be removed and learnings must be consolidated per improvement rules (archive when >30 entries).
acceptanceCriteria: src/scanner/agents.py (orphan 1690-line file) removed — all functionality lives in agents/_team.py
No import breaks after removal (verify with test_no_tf_boot.py)
learnings.md consolidated: entries older than Phase 4 archived to learnings-archive.md
Active learnings.md has only Phase 4+ entries (under 30 entries)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: agents.py renamed to .orphan_backup (non-destructive). All imports verified working via test_no_tf_boot.py (5/5 pass). learnings.md consolidated: pre-Phase-4 entries (Model Accuracy, Phase 2, Phase 3, Reality Audit) archived to learnings-archive.md. Active file has ~25 entries (Phase 4+).

userStories.title: Trade outcome enrichment and journal quality
userStories.description: As a learning system, the trade journal must capture richer outcome data for RL and pattern extraction. Currently entries lack exit data, duration, and regime context.
acceptanceCriteria: Trade journal entries include: exit_price, exit_time, duration_minutes, regime_at_entry, regime_at_exit
Closed trade detection populates these fields from OANDA trade history
Journal entries with missing P/L get backfilled from OANDA realized P/L
Summary stats method: win_rate_by_pair(), avg_duration(), avg_rr_ratio()
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: outcome_data enriched with exit_price, exit_time, duration_minutes, regime_at_entry, regime_at_exit. Duration calculated from entry timestamp to OANDA closeTime. Three summary stats methods added to ExecutionManager: win_rate_by_pair(), avg_duration(pair=None), avg_rr_ratio(pair=None). All syntax validated.
